description: This file defines enums and a class related to mathematical equations, including styling, error codes, syntax errors, and an Equation class with properties and methods for representing and handling equations within a graphing control.

classes.name: Equation
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical equation with properties for expression, styling, validation, and error states, supporting data binding and property change notifications.

methods.name: GetRequest
methods.description: Returns a string request related to the equation, possibly for processing or display.

methods.name: IsGraphableEquation
methods.description: Determines if the current equation can be graphed.

methods.name: GetExpression
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the expression as a wide string.
